card.name: Patient counts in adverse event results
card.fires_on: The word patients or subjects, or the punctuation or 'and' right after it, once a count or percentage of people has been given in a clinical trial safety result.

modes.label: Noun after a count
modes.description: The word patients or subjects directly follows a number or percentage of people with an event.
modes.example: embolic events were reported in 9/359<< patients>> (3%) receiving INLYTA (

modes.label: Punctuation after a count
modes.description: A period, comma, semicolon or 'and' closes a clause that ends in a patient count or percentage.
modes.example: ropenia occurred in 23/164 patients (14%)<< and>> 33/164 patients
